docs.title: Definition
docs.text:
A sequence \(a_n\) approaches a limit \(L\) if the terms get infinitely close to \(L\) as \(n \to \infty\).

📈 Interactive Graph: See the Limit!

(Move the slider 'n' to see the points approach y=1)

docs.title: Practice
docs.text:
Find limit of \(a_n = \frac{n+1}{n}\).

Answer:

💡 Need a Hint?

Try dividing both the numerator and denominator by $n$.

Show Solution

Divide by \(n\): $\(\lim_{n \to \infty} (1 + 1/n) = 1\)$

docs.title: Definition
docs.text: Limits describe behavior near a point, even if undefined (like \(0/0\)).

docs.title: Practice
docs.text:
Find limit of \(f(x) = \frac{x^2 - 1}{x - 1}\) as \(x \to 1\).

Answer:

💡 Need a Hint?

Use the difference of squares formula: $a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b)$.

Show Solution

Factor: \((x-1)(x+1)\). Result: \(2\).

docs.title: Practice
docs.text:
Find limit of \(f(x) = \frac{2x^2 - 2}{x - 1}\) as \(x \to 1\).

Answer:

💡 Need a Hint?

Factor out 2 first: $2(x^2 - 1)$.

Show Solution

Simplify: \(2(x+1) \to 4\).

docs.title: Task A (Multiple Choice)
docs.text:
Limit of \(a_n = \frac{3n^2 + n}{n^2 - 5}\) as \(n \to \infty\).

Select the correct answer:

0 1 3 $\infty$

Solution

Ratio of highest powers: \(3n^2 / n^2 = 3\).

docs.title: Task B⚡ Quick Formulas
docs.text:
Limit of \(f(x) = \frac{x^2 + 3x}{x}\) as \(x \to 0\).

Solution

Simplify: \(x+3 \to 3\).

⚡ Formulas

Difference of Squares:$a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b)$

Limits at Infinity:$\frac{n^k}{n^k} \to 1$, $\frac{1}{n} \to 0$

Common Limit:$\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x} = 1$
